intro.title: Saying, telling, and everything in between
You will use these in
frames: He speaks with a strong accent.
intro.note: admit, deny and insist are how you report what people said WITHOUT repeating every word — they carry the speaker's attitude.

sentences.en: It is hard to admit a mistake when the boss is angry.
sentences.cz: Je těžké přiznat chybu, když je šéf naštvaný.
accepts: It is hard to admit a mistake when the boss is angry

sentences.en: She will deny everything, even when they show her the photo.
sentences.cz: Bude všechno popírat, i když jí ukážou tu fotku.
accepts: She will deny everything, even when they show her the photo
She'll deny everything, even when they show her the photo

sentences.en: I want to apologise for my mistake because you waited an hour.
sentences.cz: Chci se omluvit za svou chybu, protože jsi hodinu čekal.
accepts: I want to apologise for my mistake because you waited an hour
I want to apologize for my mistake because you waited an hour

sentences.en: Why do you insist on paying when I invited you?
sentences.cz: Proč trváš na tom, že zaplatíš, když jsem tě pozval já?
accepts: Why do you insist on paying when I invited you?

sentences.en: Can you remind me about the meeting before you go home?
sentences.cz: Můžeš mi tu schůzku připomenout, než půjdeš domů?
accepts: Can you remind me about the meeting before you go home

sentences.en: It is not easy to persuade him to come out.
sentences.cz: Není snadné ho přemluvit, aby někam vyrazil.
accepts: It is not easy to persuade him to come out
It's not easy to persuade him to come out
It isn't easy to persuade him to come out

sentences.en: I want to warn you about the weather before you leave.
sentences.cz: Chci tě varovat před počasím, než vyrazíš.
accepts: I want to warn you about the weather before you leave

sentences.en: Please repeat the question, because I did not hear the last word.
sentences.cz: Zopakuj prosím tu otázku, protože jsem poslední slovo neslyšel.
accepts: Please repeat the question, because I did not hear the last word
Please repeat the question, because I didn't hear the last word

sentences.en: How do you spell your name when people write it in English?
sentences.cz: Jak se hláskuje tvoje jméno, když ho lidé píšou anglicky?
accepts: How do you spell your name when people write it in English

sentences.en: Can you translate this phrase which my teacher wrote on the board?
sentences.cz: Můžeš přeložit tuhle frázi, kterou učitel napsal na tabuli?
accepts: Can you translate this phrase which my teacher wrote on the board

sentences.en: She speaks with a strong accent, but everybody understands her.
sentences.cz: Mluví se silným přízvukem, ale všichni jí rozumí.
accepts: She speaks with a strong accent, but everybody understands her

sentences.en: There was a long silence after the boss asked the first question.
sentences.cz: Po první šéfově otázce nastalo dlouhé ticho.
accepts: There was a long silence after the boss asked the first question

sentences.en: Please confirm the booking before the end of the week.
sentences.cz: Potvrď prosím tu rezervaci do konce týdne.
accepts: Please confirm the booking before the end of the week

sentences.en: Both drivers claim that the other one was too fast.
sentences.cz: Oba řidiči tvrdí, že ten druhý jel moc rychle.
accepts: Both drivers claim that the other one was too fast

sentences.en: Good teachers encourage students who are afraid to speak.
sentences.cz: Dobří učitelé povzbuzují studenty, kteří se bojí mluvit.
accepts: Good teachers encourage students who are afraid to speak

sentences.en: The editor did not praise the report, but he printed it.
sentences.cz: Redaktor tu reportáž nepochválil, ale otiskl ji.
accepts: The editor did not praise the report, but he printed it
The editor didn't praise the report, but he printed it

sentences.en: It is easy to criticise, but much harder to help someone.
sentences.cz: Kritizovat je snadné, ale pomoct někomu je mnohem těžší.
accepts: It is easy to criticise, but much harder to help someone

sentences.en: The company made a short statement after the accident, but said nothing about money.
sentences.cz: Firma po té nehodě vydala krátké prohlášení, ale o penězích neřekla nic.
accepts: The company made a short statement after the accident, but said nothing about money

sentences.en: There was an announcement about the delay while we waited on the platform.
sentences.cz: Zatímco jsme čekali na nástupišti, ozvalo se hlášení o zpoždění.
accepts: There was an announcement about the delay while we waited on the platform

sentences.en: Her apology came too late because he had already left the country.
sentences.cz: Její omluva přišla příliš pozdě, protože už ze země odjel.
accepts: Her apology came too late because he had already left the country

sentences.en: The hotel got a complaint about the noise every week, but nothing changed.
sentences.cz: Hotel dostával stížnost na hluk každý týden, ale nic se nezměnilo.
accepts: The hotel got a complaint about the noise every week, but nothing changed

sentences.en: He gave her a compliment about her dress, but she did not smile.
sentences.cz: Složil jí kompliment o jejích šatech, ale ona se neusmála.
accepts: He gave her a compliment about her dress, but she did not smile

sentences.en: The rumour about the new boss was wrong, but everybody believed it.
sentences.cz: Ta fáma o novém šéfovi byla nepravdivá, ale všichni jí věřili.
accepts: The rumour about the new boss was wrong, but everybody believed it

sentences.en: The gossip in the office is worse than the work.
sentences.cz: Drby v kanceláři jsou horší než ta práce.
accepts: The gossip in the office is worse than the work

sentences.en: It was a misunderstanding, not a real problem.
sentences.cz: Bylo to nedorozumění, ne opravdový problém.
accepts: It was a misunderstanding, not a real problem

sentences.en: I have no contact with the school friends who moved to Germany.
sentences.cz: Nemám kontakt se spolužáky, kteří se odstěhovali do Německa.
accepts: I have no contact with the school friends who moved to Germany

sentences.en: This phrase is difficult to translate because the Czech word is longer.
sentences.cz: Tuhle frázi je těžké přeložit, protože české slovo je delší.
accepts: This phrase is difficult to translate because the Czech word is longer

sentences.en: The article started with a quote from the minister who lost his job.
sentences.cz: Ten článek začínal citátem ministra, který přišel o místo.
accepts: The article started with a quote from the minister who lost his job

sentences.en: I did not like his tone when he answered the question.
sentences.cz: Nelíbil se mi jeho tón, když na tu otázku odpovídal.
accepts: I did not like his tone when he answered the question
I didn't like his tone when he answered the question

sentences.en: She is fluent in German because she lived in Vienna for three years.
sentences.cz: Mluví plynně německy, protože tři roky žila ve Vídni.
accepts: She is fluent in German because she lived in Vienna for three years

sentences.en: Our teacher is not a native speaker, but her English is very good.
sentences.cz: Naše učitelka není rodilá mluvčí, ale anglicky umí moc dobře.
accepts: Our teacher is not a native speaker, but her English is very good
Our teacher isn't a native speaker, but her English is very good

sentences.en: Their children are bilingual because the father is English.
sentences.cz: Jejich děti jsou dvojjazyčné, protože otec je Angličan.
accepts: Their children are bilingual because the father is English

sentences.en: Young people use slang that their parents do not understand.
sentences.cz: Mladí lidé používají slang, kterému jejich rodiče nerozumí.
accepts: Young people use slang that their parents do not understand
Young people use slang that their parents don't understand

sentences.en: I learn ten new words a week, but my vocabulary is still small.
sentences.cz: Učím se deset nových slovíček týdně, ale slovní zásobu mám pořád malou.
accepts: I learn ten new words a week, but my vocabulary is still small

sentences.en: He made a small gesture with his hand when the bus arrived.
sentences.cz: Když autobus přijel, udělal rukou malé gesto.
accepts: He made a small gesture with his hand when the bus arrived

sentences.en: Please whisper, because the baby is sleeping in the next room.
sentences.cz: Šeptej prosím, protože ve vedlejším pokoji spí miminko.
accepts: Please whisper, because the baby is sleeping in the next room

use_sentences.prompt: It is hard to say you made a mistake in front of the boss.

use_sentences.prompt: She will say no to everything.

She'll deny everything

use_sentences.prompt: Can you tell me again about the meeting before you go home?
use_sentences.en: Can you remind me again about the meeting before you go home?

use_sentences.en: It is not easy to persuade him to come out.

use_sentences.prompt: I want to tell you about the weather before it is a problem.
